Name: Pinned Mine Elevator
Author: LavandaEzh
Description:
When farming ore or monster eradication goals in the Mines, constantly aiming at the same floor button in the elevator menu gets old fast. With [b]Pinned Mine Elevator[/b], you don't have to aim at all.

[b]How it works[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Only in the Mines:[/b] A vanilla-styled hanging tag appears right under your Quest Log only while you're at the Mine entrance or underground, keeping your screen clean elsewhere.[/*]
[*][b]Click to Pin:[/b] Click the unlocked tag and pick your target floor from the elevator menu.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Travel:[/b] Interact with the elevator to immediately jump to your pinned floor—no menu, no extra clicks.[/*]
[*][b]Click to Unpin:[/b] Click the locked tag again at any time to clear the pin and use the elevator normally.[/*]
[/list][b]Details[/b]
[list]
[*]Remembers your pinned floor per save file.[/*]
[*]Matches the vanilla UI style, fading smoothly during transitions and dimming under open menus.[/*]
[*]Includes English and Russian translations.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Pinned Mine Elevator
Manifest.Description: Adds a lock button under the journal to pin a specific mine elevator floor.
